 Kickoff is at 7 p.m. ET on TBS, truTV, HBO Max, Universo and Peacock and on radio on Westwood One and Fútbol de Primera November 17, 2026 LINEUP NOTES 
 USMNT vs. HAITI 
 Concacaf Nations League Quarterfinal 
 November 17, 2026
TQL Stadium; Cincinnati, Ohio
Pre-Game Coverage: 6 p.m. ET on TBS, truTV, HBO Max, Universo and Peacock
Kickoff: 7 p.m. ET on TBS, truTV, HBO Max, Universo and Peacock
Radio: Westwood One, Fútbol de Primera
 Fans can follow the USMNT on X ( @USMNT ), Instagram ( @USMNT ), Facebook and the official U.S. Soccer App.
 Today’s USMNT Starting XI vs. Haiti: 18-Diego Kochen, 3-Chris Richards, 4-Tyler Adams (Capt.), 5-Antonee Robinson, 6-Auston Trusty, 8-Weston McKennie, 9-Julian Hall, 10-Christian Pulisic, 14-Sebastian Berhalter, 16-Alex Freeman, 17-Malik Tillman
 Substitutes: 1-Matt Freese, 19-Brian Schwake, 2-Reed Baker-Whiting, 7-Jack McGlynn, 11-Cavan Sullivan, 12-Neil Pierre, 13-Adri Mehmeti, 15-Bryan Reynolds, 20-Folarin Balogun, 21-Mathis Albert, 22-Mark McKenzie, 23-Santiago Castañeda 
 Not Dressed: Justin Ellis
 LINEUP NOTES 
 USMNT Starting XI Caps (including this match): Christian Pulisic (92), Weston McKennie (73), Tyler Adams (64), Antonee Robinson (64), Chris Richards (45), Malik Tillman (41), Alex Freeman (28), Sebastian Berhalter (24), Auston Trusty (16), Julian Hall (6), Diego Kochen (4).
 USMNT Concacaf Nations League Caps (including this match): Weston McKennie (20), Christian Pulisic (17), Antonee Robinson (14), Tyler Adams (8), Malik Tillman (8), Chris Richards (7), Auston Trusty (5), Sebastian Berhalter (2), Alex Freeman (2), Julian Hall (2), Diego Kochen (2).
 The Starting XI averages 42 caps and has an average age of 25 years, 164 days.
 Mauricio Pochettino runs out the same Starting XI that began last Saturday’s 6-0 first leg win against Haiti. Tonight is the first time since FIFA World Cup 2026 knockout stage matches against Bosnia and Herzegovina and Belgium, with the same lineup in consecutive games.
 Tyler Adams will captain the USMNT for the 17th time.
 Weston McKennie will earn his 20th cap for the USMNT in the Concacaf Nations League, the most all-time of any USMNT player.
 Chris Richards and Auston Trusty will partner in defense for the fourth time, after posting shutouts in their previous two outings together against Mexico and Haiti.
 Three players in the Starting XI have played in all 15 matches this year: Sebastian Berhalter, Alex Freeman and Malik Tillman.
 Diego Kochen will make his fourth appearance in goal and second consecutive after earning a clean in his most recent outing against Haiti.
 After earning his fourth senior cap today and first in official competition, Diego Kochen is now cap-tied to the U.S.
 At 18 years and 238 days, Red Bull New York forward Julian Hall is the youngest player in the Starting XI.
 Julian Hall and Malik Tillman are tied for second-most goals scored by a USMNT player in 2026 with four.
 The all-time series against Haiti currently stands at 9W-6L-5D across 72 years of competition.
 The USMNT holds a 2W-0L-2D record overall at TQL Stadium since its opening in 2021.
 In the team’s most recent match in Cincinnati on Sept. 10, 2024 against New Zealand, Mauricio Pochettino was named head coach of the USMNT.
 The USMNT has recorded a 16W-3L-5D record in Ohio.
 Justin Ellis is the lone player on the 24-man roster not dressing.
 Teams are allowed five substitutions for today’s match. Each can use three substitution moments as well as make changes at halftime.
